note: Forward-outcome ledger for each session's Strong Buy and Strong Sell cohorts, split all / flash (first session at the rating) / persistent (3+ consecutive sessions at the rating). Outcomes are close-to-close returns 5 and 10 trading sessions later against the equal-weight mean return of that session's whole board over the same window; a symbol that did not trade on the target session is measured at its last traded close on or before it, and a member is excluded from a horizon when its forward window contains a bar-to-bar move over 15% (likely corporate action) or no usable close. Unresolved horizons stay pending — never filled with backtest rates.
